features.name: core_scaled_centroid_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance from the training-fold centroid over broad study-shape fields after scaling by training-fold standard deviations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves Euclidean neighborhoods by putting broad study-shape variables on comparable scale and adding a centrality coordinate.

features.name: early_local_profile_distance
features.description: Generic prototype distance to an early, local, low-complexity study profile: low phase and enrollment, one country, modest evidence, and limited deployment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives KNN a smooth axis for proximity to small, local, exploratory trial geometry.

features.name: deployed_multisite_profile_distance
features.description: Generic prototype distance to a mature, deployed, multisite study profile with stronger evidence and randomization.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps group rows close to a mature deployment geometry while keeping the reference generic and unsupervised.

features.name: ai_method_specificity_similarity
features.description: Weighted 0-1 similarity summarizing explicit AI-method terminology from algorithm, machine-learning, deep-learning, and AI mentions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Makes text-derived AI-method signals comparable on a bounded scale.

features.name: digital_tooling_similarity
features.description: Weighted 0-1 similarity for software, mobile-app, wearable, and real-world deployment signals.
features.expected_model_benefit: Places digital implementation evidence on a shared 0-1 scale for distance calculations.

features.name: trial_design_rigor_similarity
features.description: Weighted 0-1 similarity capturing stronger evidence, randomization, blinding, and later phase bucket.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups rows with similar methodological strength rather than raw mixed-scale codes.

features.name: participant_scope_similarity
features.description: Weighted 0-1 similarity for population breadth using sex_all, child inclusion, older-adult inclusion, and enrollment bucket.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a participant-scope coordinate so neighbors share similar population breadth.

features.name: geographic_reach_similarity
features.description: Bounded 0-1 similarity for geographic reach using log-scaled country count and international-trial status.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes geography, preventing country_count from dominating while preserving reach.

features.name: safety_governance_similarity
features.description: Weighted 0-1 similarity summarizing safety, privacy, and bias mentions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact axis for safety, privacy, and bias context, improving semantic neighbor matching.

features.name: high_rigor_deployment_cluster
features.description: Unsupervised 0/1 indicator for rows combining stronger evidence or deployment with broader geography or randomization.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a crisp neighborhood anchor for more mature, broader studies without using outcome information.

features.name: workflow_fit_semantic_score
features.description: 0.0-1.0 domain judgment of how naturally the AI component fits routine clinical workflow, based only on non-sponsor coded row fields such as ai_use_type, real_world_deployment_score, digital-tool mentions, study status, and design fields.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a semantic coordinate that groups rows with similar practical deployment context.

features.name: ai_component_centrality_semantic_score
features.description: 0.0-1.0 domain judgment of how central the AI component is to the intervention or assessment, based only on non-sponsor coded row fields such as ai_use_type, AI terminology mentions, evidence_strength_score, and real_world_deployment_score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps KNN separate rows where AI is the main study mechanism from rows where it is ancillary.
